title: select_transaction
description: Open the detail screen for one transaction in the currently shown (and usually filtered) list — the one the customer has confirmed is the charge in question, e.g. 'yes, that one — Riverside Auto'. This opens its detail view; it does not start a dispute. If the id is not known, leave it unset and the app selects the single highlighted match.

transactionId.description: Opaque id of the transaction to open. When unset, the app opens the sole highlighted/filtered match if there is exactly one.
